controles.affirmation: Environ 76 000 plaignants americains poursuivent JNJ pour cancers lies au talc (au 28 juin 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 28, 2026, there are approximately 76,000 plaintiffs in the United States with direct claims against the Company and its affiliates in pending lawsuits regarding injuries allegedly due to the use of body powders containing talc, primarily JOHNSON'S Baby Powder. (10-Q 2026-07-23)

controles.affirmation: Les trois procedures Chapter 11 (Red River, Pecos River) ont ete rejetees, reprise des proces au cas par cas
controles.verbatim_source: the Company filed a series of three Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. Ultimately, each of the bankruptcy proceedings was dismissed and, as a result, the Company reversed substantially all, or approximately $7.0 billion... Litigation in the tort system recommenced.

controles.verbatim_source: the total present value of the reserve for talc related matters is approximately $3.7 billion, comprising executed settlement agreements, litigation defense and other costs. Approximately 40% of the reserve is recorded as a current liability.

controles.affirmation: Proces ovariens et mesotheliomes programmes dans plusieurs Etats en 2026 et au-dela
controles.verbatim_source: As in years prior, both ovarian cancer and mesothelioma trials are being scheduled in various state courts throughout 2026 and beyond.

controles.affirmation: MDL ovarien : procedure ouverte en juillet 2026 pouvant mener au rejet, apres retrait de deux experts des plaignants
controles.verbatim_source: In May 2026, the Special Master held evidentiary hearings on the Company's specific causation motion. Thereafter, the plaintiffs withdrew two of their specific causation experts. In June...
controles.correction_proposee: Passage tronque a 'In June' dans l'extrait lisible, mais la sequence (retrait de deux experts, suite de procedure) est bien dans le document. Formulation ATT deja prudente ('pouvant mener au rejet').

controles.affirmation: Environ 0,9 Md $ restant a verser au titre des accords opioides

controles.affirmation: Action collective antitrust STELARA : classe certifiee en decembre 2025, dossier en appel
controles.verbatim_source: The complaint alleges that Janssen violated federal and state antitrust laws... by delaying biosimilar competition with STELARA... In December 2025, the court granted plaintiffs' motion for class certification... In March 2026, plaintiffs appealed to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance mineure : l'appel de mars 2026 porte sur le summary judgment accorde a Janssen (brevets Momenta), pas sur la certification de classe.

controles.affirmation: Plainte False Claims Act visant DePuy Synthes deposee en juin 2026 (Sud de la Floride)
controles.verbatim_source: In June 2026, three Relators filed an Amended False Claims Act Complaint in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida alleging the Company and DePuy Synthes... caused the submission of false claims... the complaint was served following a decision by the Department of Justice to decline intervening in the case.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : il s'agit d'une plainte AMENDEE deposee en juin 2026 par des relators concurrents, et le DOJ a refuse d'intervenir. L'ATT ne pretend pas a une enquete DOJ, donc pas de sur-affirmation.

controles.affirmation: Action d'actionnaires depuis 2018 sur la communication autour de l'amiante dans le talc
controles.verbatim_source: ...federal securities laws by failing to disclose alleged asbestos contamination in body powders containing talc... In December 2023, the court granted plaintiffs' motion for class certification. In July 2025, the Third Circuit affirmed... the Supreme Court denied in April 2026. Expert discovery is proceeding.

controles.verbatim_source: DARZALEX... accounted for approximately 15.0% of the Company's total revenues for fiscal 2025... Royalty rate ranges from 12% to 20% of total DARZALEX net sales. controles.verbatim_source: In October 2025, the Company announced its intention to separate its Orthopaedics business. The Company continues to explore multiple paths to effect the planned separation with a targeted completion within 18 to 24 months after the initial announcement.
